summary: Design-only acceptance specification for the future Next Experiment Brainstorm Checker, automation/acceptance/next-experiment-review.yaml, following the REG-CANDIDATES-design / AUT-VPG-design / DASH-S8-design precedent (a design memo/spec commit with no checker code, no validator, no test, no generated review, and NO computed verdict for any of the 8 real candidates). Defines: (1) purpose -- the future checker reads accepted registries and produces a deterministic ranked planning review; GO means human-planning-review-only, never authorizes an experiment or test read, and no verdict may modify a candidate record or auto-create/modify an experiment_queue.yaml entry; (2) authoritative read-only sources (experiment_candidates.yaml, paper_registry.yaml, frontier.yaml, goals.yaml, datasets.yaml, reference_evidence.yaml, experiment_identity.yaml, artifact_manifest.csv, accepted protocol-freeze records) with an authority_rule forbidding duplication, plus a reference_resolution_requirement that every candidate_id/paper_id/literature_gap_id/dataset_id/goal_id/evaluation_id/reference-evidence key/protocol_id/repository-relative path must be RE-resolved at generation time, never cached, with any unresolved reference becoming a blocker; (3) the future generated artifact location automation/reviews/next_experiment_review.yaml (a generated planning artifact, not a source registry, not created by this spec) plus the four likely-later files (checker script, validator, tests, the generated review itself), none created now; (4) a full output_schema (schema_version, review_id, generated_at, source_fingerprint, policy_version, authoritative_sources, candidate_count, ranking_policy, entries[] with candidate_id/rank/target_gap/direction_tags/scientific_promise/practical_readiness/data_readiness/split_safety/literature_support_summary/current_evidence_summary/prior_negative_evidence_summary/dataset_readiness/allowed_split/test_read_risk/frozen_protocol_requirement/blockers/material_difference_requirement{required,status,basis_refs,explanation}/derived_verdict/verdict_reasons/required_human_actions/claim_boundaries, and a summary{go_count,review_count,no_go_count,unresolved_reference_count}) plus a no-duplication rule (short paraphrase + pointer only, reusing the same text-length/markdown-table heuristics already enforced by the paper and candidate validators); (5) material-difference derivation as a value COMPUTED at generation time (the candidate registry does not define this field) with three cases (no prior negative evidence -> not_applicable; prior negative evidence with no stated difference -> missing, forces NO-GO; prior negative evidence with a stated difference -> stated_unverified, caps at REVIEW) and an explicit rule that the checker never itself certifies a claimed difference as sufficient; (6) derived verdict rules split into force_no_go / force_or_cap_at_review / may_permit_go with explicit precedence (NO-GO overrides REVIEW overrides GO, and verdict_reasons must list every fired rule, not only the deciding one) and a note that GO always still means human-planning-review-only; (7) four separately-reported dimensions (scientific_promise, practical_readiness, data_readiness, split_safety) that must never collapse into one opaque score, with execution_authorization explicitly NOT a reportable dimension and never a positive outcome; (8) a fully deterministic 5-key ranking tuple (derived_verdict, data_readiness, allowed_split, evidence_strength using the exact accepted controlled-vocabulary order, candidate_id alphabetical as final tie-breaker) with an explicit statement that ranking is never written back into the candidate registry; (9) an idempotency mechanism keyed on a deterministic source_fingerprint digest over every authoritative input file plus policy_version, such that an unchanged fingerprint preserves the existing review_id/generated_at and produces byte-identical output, and generated_at alone must never be the reason two runs over identical inputs differ; (10) explicit safety boundaries (incapable of shell commands, training/evaluation, constructing a runnable experiment command, held-out-test read/write, frozen-test-read authorization, modifying the candidate registry/experiment_queue.yaml/any accepted registry, thesis-claim changes, literature promotion, clinical/deployment claims, or network access) with the ONLY permitted write target being automation/reviews/next_experiment_review.yaml; (11) future task boundaries documenting this step as NEXT-EXP-REVIEW-design (unregistered in tasks.yaml, per the now three-times-confirmed design-only precedent) and the future NEXT-EXP-REVIEW implementation task's likely dependencies (REG-CANDIDATES, REG-PAPERS, REG-GOALS, REG-DATASETS, REF-EVID, REG-EXPERIMENT-ID), with protocol-freeze/experiment-queue/dashboard rendering explicitly named as separate downstream systems this layer never touches. YAML parsing verified (python yaml.safe_load succeeds; 25 top-level keys). Precedent inspection confirmed: REG-CANDIDATES-design (receipt 2026-07-10T225005Z + approval 2026-07-10T225042Z), AUT-VPG-design (receipt 2026-07-10T064710Z + approval 2026-07-10T065209Z), and DASH-S8-design (receipt 2026-07-10T064711Z + approval 2026-07-10T065228Z) all use a '-design'-suffixed task_id with NO corresponding automation/tasks.yaml entry (grep confirms zero NEXT-EXP-REVIEW matches in tasks.yaml) -- update_dashboard.py's verification ledger processes any done-receipt's task_id whether or not it is registered ('incl. tasks not in tasks.yaml, e.g. legacy'), so a tasks.yaml entry is expected only at NEXT-EXP-REVIEW implementation time, not at this design-only step. No experiment recommendation was produced anywhere in the spec. No candidate registry (automation/registry/experiment_candidates.yaml) was modified. No automation/experiment_queue.yaml action occurred. No experiment, training, validation, model evaluation, export, threshold selection, or test read occurred; no command contained --split; no web access or Codex-workbench access occurred. No existing registry, validator, test, acceptance spec (including the design contract itself), task registry, changelog, roadmap, or dashboard file was modified -- confirmed via git status --short showing exactly one new untracked file and zero modified tracked files at claim time.

git status --short -> exactly one new untracked file (automation/acceptance/next-experiment-review.yaml); zero modified tracked files
